description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'Configuration' that models IDE configuration data such as source roots, jar files, and excluded directories. It includes logic to traverse directories, read configuration files, handle symbolic links, and determine source roots for Java files. It is part of a tool for generating IDE project configurations within an Android development environment.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Immutable class representing IDE configuration details such as source roots, jar files, and excluded directories, with methods to traverse project directories and parse configuration files.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configuration by traversing the directory tree and reading exclude patterns.

methods.name: readExcludes
methods.description: Reads and compiles exclude patterns from configuration files, including global, vendor, and local excludes.

methods.name: readVendorExcludes
methods.description: Reads vendor-specific exclude files and adds patterns to out.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Recursively traverses directories to find source roots (.java), jar files (.jar), and excluded directories, honoring exclude patterns.

methods.name: rootOf
methods.description: Determines the source root directory of a given Java source file based on its package declaration and directory structure.

methods.name: parsePackageName
methods.description: Parses a Java source file to extract its package name.

methods.name: excludesUnderSourceRoots
methods.description: Returns the set of excluded directories that are under source roots.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Reads a file containing regex patterns (one per line) and adds compiled patterns to the provided collection.
